notes.title: The Real 0.9.107 Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch update 0.9.107[/h1]
Previous attempt was screwy. This one shouldn't be.

[h2]Display Settings[/h2]
This update adds the much requested resolution and window display settings to the Title/Login screen and Settings panel under "video".

We realize the list of video modes is ... quite lengthy. We will try to filter it down in the next update.

[h2]Lucious Lexi[/h2]
Lexi is a sizzling hot blonde Rare Succubus from the Sancuary of Sin. She can drop from Battle chests, Vault chests and even the free chests!

Thank you for playing.
